0.name: Grotle

0.description: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

0.name: Infernape
0.description: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

U1.name: Pride Piplup
U1.description: It's an adorable little thing - as cute as any child - but it's also prideful, unwilling to let others tell it what to do.

0.name: Prinplup
0.description: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

0.name: Empoleon
0.description: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

0.name: Starly
0.description: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

0.name: Staravia
0.description: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

0.name: Staraptor
0.description: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

0.name: Bidoof
0.description: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

E1.name: Easter Bidoof
E1.description: It lives in groups by the water. During Easter, it plays the role of Easter Bunny for nearby villages to entertain the children.

0.name: Bibarel
0.description: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

0.name: Kricketot
0.description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

0.name: Kricketune
0.description: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

U1.name: Wizard Kricketune
U1.description: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces magic.

0.name: Shinx
0.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

0.name: Luxio
0.description: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

0.name: Luxray
0.description: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

0.name: Budew
0.description: When the sun’s light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon’s head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

0.name: Roserade
0.description: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.

U1.name: Pride Roserade
U1.description: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with poses of all sorts to show its strength and pride.

0.name: Cranidos
0.description: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

0.name: Rampardos
0.description: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

0.name: Shieldon
0.description: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

0.name: Bastiodon
0.description: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

0.name: Burmy
0.description: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

1.name: Sandy Burmy
1.description: It creates a cloak by weaving together sand, mud, and silk it has spat out. This earthen cloak is ruined by wind and rain, so the Pokémon hides away in caves and other such places.

2.name: Trash Burmy
2.description: When confronted by a lack of other materials, Burmy will create its cloak using dust and refuse. The cloak seems to be more comfortable than one would think.

0.name: Wormadam
0.description: The cloak—fashioned from plant matter—has merged with the Pokémon and is now part of the body, like fur or skin. I suspect this fusion is an effect of the energy involved in evolution.

1.name: sandy cloak wormadam
1.description: Its earthen skin is reasonably hard—it has no problem repelling a Starly’s pecking, at least.

2.name: trash cloak wormadam
2.description: Its body, composed of refuse, blends in to the scenery so much as to be inconspicuous. This seems to be the perfect way for the Pokémon to evade the detection of predators.

C1.name: Snowmadam
C1.description: Its cloak looks to be made of soft, fluffy snow, but don't be deceived. This packed, hardened snow offers it sturdy protection and gives frostbite to any who touch it.

0.name: Mothim
0.description: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

0.name: Combee
0.description: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers nectar from flowers to please Vespiquen.

0.name: Vespiquen
0.description: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

0.name: Pachirisu
0.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

0.name: Buizel
0.description: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

0.name: Floatzel
0.description: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and help fishers carry what they caught.

S1.name: Ranger Floatzel
S1.description: It is a common sight around cave entrances. It is known to rescue people and keep evil at bay.

0.name: Cherubi
0.description: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.

0.name: Cherrim
0.description: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim’s folded petals.

1.name: Sunshine Cherrim
1.description: Cheerfully active on sunny days. Immediately closes its petals and becomes immobile once the sun becomes hidden, however.

E1.name: Blossom Cherrim
E1.description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud. The more blossom it has, the darker their past.

0.name: Shellos
0.description: It oozes a purple fluid to deter enemies. Apparently, there are more West Sea Shellos now than there were in the past.

1.name: East Sea Shellos
1.description: This Pokémon can often be seen along seashores. It's capable of spending a limited amount of time on land.

0.name: Gastrodon
0.description: It appears on beaches where the waters are shallow. Once it catches prey, it will slowly melt them with its mucus before slurping them up.

1.name: East Sea Gastrodon
1.description: Fishers say that they didn't see many of these Pokémon in the past, but this form of Gastrodon is now increasing in number.

0.name: Ambipom
0.description: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

0.name: Drifloon
0.description: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “signpost for wandering spirits.”

0.name: Drifblim
0.description: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can’t be a fixed destination.

U1.name: Drifboy
U1.description: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But nobody knows where you end up…

0.name: Buneary
0.description: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

E1.name: Egg Basket Buneary
E1.description: Buneary can crack eggs by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack is useful for hard boiled eggs.

0.name: Lopunny
0.description: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

1.name: mega lopunny
1.description: Mega Evolution awakens its combative instincts. It has shed any fur that got in the way of its attacks.

U1.name: Doll Lopunny
U1.description: Once the hot seasons end, its coat will be replaced with soft wooly fur that holds a lot of insulating air in preparation for the colder weather.

0.name: Mismagius
0.description: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

0.name: Honchkrow
0.description: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

0.name: Glameow
0.description: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

0.name: Purugly
0.description: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

0.name: Chingling
0.description: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

0.name: Stunky
0.description: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

0.name: Skuntank
0.description: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

0.name: Bronzor
0.description: They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious power.

0.name: Bronzong
0.description: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

0.name: Bonsly
0.description: From its eyes, it can expel excess moisture from its body. This liquid is similar in composition to human sweat.

0.name: Mime Jr.
0.description: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

0.name: Happiny
0.description: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

0.name: Chatot
0.description: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

0.name: Spiritomb
0.description: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

0.name: Gible
0.description: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

0.name: Gabite
0.description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

0.name: Garchomp
0.description: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

1.name: mega garchomp
1.description: Its disposition is more vicious than before its Mega Evolution. Garchomp carves its opponents up with the scythes on both arms.

0.name: Munchlax
0.description: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

0.name: Riolu
0.description: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions, such as joy and rage, in the form of waves.

0.name: Lucario
0.description: A well-trained one can use its aura to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

1.name: mega lucario
1.description: Bathed in explosive energy, its combative instincts have awakened. For its enemies, it has no mercy whatsoever.

0.name: Hippopotas
0.description: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

0.name: Hippowdon
0.description: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

0.name: Skorupi
0.description: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

0.name: Drapion
0.description: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

0.name: Croagunk
0.description: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

0.name: Toxicroak
0.description: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

U1.name: Rogue Toxicroak
U1.description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin that is used for battles in dungeons.

0.name: Carnivine
0.description: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

H1.name: Overgrown Carnivine
H1.description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling flowers and gulps them down.

0.name: Finneon
0.description: It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its skin, which then shine. This appears to be a form of camouflage.

0.name: Lumineon
0.description: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.

0.name: Mantyke
0.description: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

0.name: Snover
0.description: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

0.name: Abomasnow
0.description: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

0.name: Weavile
0.description: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

H1.name: Sage of Shadows
H1.description: It travels with other sages, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. It brings down its prey with shadow magic.

0.name: Magnezone
0.description: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed Magneton’s molecular structure, turning it into Magnezone.

0.name: Lickilicky
0.description: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky’s height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

0.name: Rhyperior
0.description: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

0.name: Tangrowth
0.description: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

0.name: Electivire
0.description: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

0.name: Magmortar
0.description: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

0.name: Togekiss
0.description: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

0.name: Yanmega
0.description: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey’s most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

0.name: Leafeon
0.description: The younger they are, the more they smell like fresh grass. With age, their fragrance takes on the odor of fallen leaves.

0.name: Glaceon
0.description: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

C1.name: Snowglobe Glaceon
C1.description: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

0.name: Gliscor
0.description: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

0.name: Porygon-Z
0.description: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon’s offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

U1.name: Porygon-X
U1.description: An attempt to fix its faulty programming failed, corrupting it further and resulting in this glitched form.

0.name: Gallade
0.description: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

0.name: Froslass
0.description: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

2.description: The model of washing machine that Rotom can inspirit has been discontinued, so these appliances are now traded at high prices.

3.name: rotom frost
3.description: The special motor within the refrigerator is the key to bringing about Rotom’s change in form.

4.name: rotom fan
4.description: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

0.name: Mesprit
0.description: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

0.name: Azelf
0.description: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

0.description: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

1.description: Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. Dialga now wields such colossal strength that one must conclude this is its true form.

1.name: origin forme palkia
1.description: It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is Palkia’s strategy for gaining Arceus’s powers.

0.name: Heatran
0.description: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

0.name: Regigigas

0.name: Giratina
0.description: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

1.description: Giratina loses its legs upon changing into this form. I believe this Pokémon must hail from a world where the heavens and the earth are as one, though I have no way of proving it.

0.description: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui’s coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

0.name: Darkrai
0.description: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village’s inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

U1.description: With its tail, Serperior holds a lantern to celebrate Lunar New Year. Its wooden body radiates charm and grace.

0.description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

0.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

1.name: hisuian samurott
1.description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon’s evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

0.name: Patrat
0.description: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

0.name: Watchog
0.description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

0.name: Lillipup
0.description: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

0.name: Herdier
0.description: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

0.name: Stoutland
0.description: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

0.name: Purrloin
0.description: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

U1.name: Bard Purrloin
U1.description: Its cute music act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It disappears in the night after every performance.

0.name: Liepard
0.description: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

0.name: Pansage
0.description: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

0.name: Simisage
0.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

0.name: Pansear
0.description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

0.name: Simisear
0.description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

0.name: Panpour
0.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

0.name: Simipour
0.description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

0.name: Munna
0.description: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

0.name: Musharna
0.description: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

0.name: Pidove
0.description: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

0.name: Tranquill
0.description: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

0.name: Unfezant
0.description: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

C1.name: Lovebird Unfezant
C1.description: Males swing their head plumage to attract females. The females' flying abilities are shown to impress the male.

0.name: Blitzle
0.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

0.name: Zebstrika
0.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

0.name: Roggenrola
0.description: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

U1.name: Sage of Snaring
U1.description: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it can be used to make objects fly.

0.name: Boldore
0.description: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

0.name: Gigalith
0.description: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

0.name: Woobat
0.description: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

0.name: Swoobat
0.description: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

U1.name: Cloubat
U1.description: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits thunder sounds strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

0.name: Drilbur
0.description: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

0.name: Excadrill
0.description: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

0.name: Audino
0.description: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

C1.name: Elf Audino
C1.description: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Elf Audino can find out other creatures’ wishes and desires.

0.name: Timburr
0.description: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

U1.name: Timber Timburr
U1.description: It fights by swinging an axe around. It is close to evolving when it can chop down small trees without difficulty.

0.name: Gurdurr
0.description: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

0.name: Conkeldurr
0.description: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

0.name: Tympole
0.description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

0.name: Palpitoad
0.description: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

0.name: Seismitoad
0.description: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

0.name: Throh
0.description: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

0.name: Sawk
0.description: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

0.name: Sewaddle
0.description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

0.name: Swadloon
0.description: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

0.name: Leavanny
0.description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

H1.name: Leavanette
H1.description: This Pokémon has strong attacking instincts. The leaf-like arms are sharp enough to slice a thick steel beam in half with one stroke.

0.name: Venipede
0.description: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

0.name: Whirlipede
0.description: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

0.name: Scolipede
0.description: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

0.name: Cottonee
0.description: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

0.name: Whimsicott
0.description: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

0.name: Petilil
0.description: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

0.name: Lilligant
0.description: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

1.name: hisuian lilligant
1.description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

H1.name: La Catrina Hisuian Lilligant
H1.description: The fragrance of its flower differs slightly on Día de Muertos, its scent becomes sweeter. Sniffing the aroma calms your heart and mind.

C1.name: Poinsettia Lilligant
C1.description: Essential oils made from Lilligant poinsettia flowers have a sublime scent. These are in a lot of homes during Christmas.

0.name: Basculin
0.description: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.

1.name: basculin blue-Striped from
1.description: The power of its jaws is immense—enough to leave teeth marks in iron sheets. Its personality is also extremely vicious.

2.name: White-Striped Basculin
2.description: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

0.name: Sandile
0.description: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.

0.name: Krokorok
0.description: Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the middle of the night.

0.name: Krookodile
0.description: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

0.name: Darumaka
0.description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

1.name: galarian darumaka
1.description: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

0.name: Darmanitan
0.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

1.name: zen mode darmanitan
1.description: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.

2.name: galarian standard mode darmanitan
2.description: Though it has a gentle disposition, it’s also very strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its head before going for a headbutt.

3.name: Galarian Zen Darmanitan
3.description: Darmanitan takes this form when enraged. It won’t stop spewing flames until its rage has settled, even if its body starts to melt.

0.name: Maractus
0.description: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

0.name: Dwebble
0.description: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

0.name: Crustle
0.description: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

0.name: Scraggy
0.description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

0.name: Scrafty
0.description: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

0.name: Sigilyph
0.description: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

0.name: Yamask
0.description: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

1.name: galarian yamask
1.description: It’s said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.

H1.name: Honoring Yamask
H1.description: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. They search for their families on Día de Muertos, connecting with loved ones and sharing memories of its former life.

0.name: Cofagrigus
0.description: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

0.name: Tirtouga
0.description: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

0.name: Carracosta
0.description: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

0.name: Archen
0.description: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

0.name: Archeops
0.description: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

0.name: Trubbish
0.description: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

0.name: Garbodor
0.description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

1.name: gigantamax garbodor
1.description: It sprays toxic gas from its mouth and fingers. If the gas engulfs you, the toxins will seep in all the way down to your bones.

0.name: Zorua
0.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

1.name: hisuian zorua
1.description: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

C1.name: Santa H. Zorua
C1.description: It changes into the forms of others to disguise itself while bringing presents. Apparently, its true form is Santa Claus!

0.name: Zoroark
0.description: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

1.name: hisuian zoroark
1.description: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark’s own body.

2.name: Foroark
2.description: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Foroark will scare them almost to death.

0.name: Minccino
0.description: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

C1.name: Pyjama Minccino
C1.description: These Pokémon like things neat and tidy during Christmas. They are always watching the house and helping decorate the Christmas tree.

0.name: Cinccino
0.description: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

0.name: Gothita
0.description: Beware of touching the ribbon-shaped feelers that control its psychic power. Gothita will begin bawling if you do.

0.name: Gothorita
0.description: Using its psychic power, it arranges pebbles to form the shapes of constellations. Some people believe this Pokémon came from outer space.

H1.name: Pumpkin Gothorita
H1.description: Using its psychic power, it arranges pumpkins to form the shapes of evil spirits. Some people believe this Pokémon came from outer space.

0.name: Gothitelle
0.description: It gazes at the stars to predict the future. It acts somewhat detached because it has seen the end of all existence.

H1.name: Monarch Gothitelle
H1.description: Instead of gazing at the stars for the future, Monarch Gothitelle gazes into the past, through the souls of the departed, in order to share favored memories with their loved ones on Día de Muertos.

0.name: Solosis
0.description: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

0.name: Duosion
0.description: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

0.name: Reuniclus
0.description: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

0.name: Ducklett
0.description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

E1.name: Baby Ducklett
E1.description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They can swim from day one and start diving after the first week.

S1.name: Waterpolo Ducklett
S1.description: These bird Pokémon are excellent at waterpolo. They swim around in the water throwing balls and plants at each other to train.

0.name: Swanna
0.description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

E1.name: Flower Family Swanna
E1.description: Swanna start to gather flowers at dawn. It makes flower crowns for the new duckletts.

0.name: Vanillite
0.description: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

0.name: Vanillish
0.description: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

0.name: Vanilluxe
0.description: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

0.name: Deerling
0.description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

1.name: Summer Deerling
1.description: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. When a distinct grassy smell starts to waft from one, you know that summer has begun.

2.name: Autumn Deerling
2.description: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.

3.name: Winter Deerling
3.description: This Pokémon will playfully headbutt those it gets along well with. It has antlers hidden under its flower, so the headbutts are a little painful.

C1.name: Reindeer Deerling
C1.description: The color and scent of their fur change to match the Christmas celebration. People use it to mark the Christmas days.

0.name: Sawsbuck
0.description: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

1.name: Summer Sawsbuck
1.description: This Pokémon's leaves can be made into a black tea, the taste of which varies depending on the region of origin. Paldea's is especially aromatic.

2.name: Autumn Sawsbuck
2.description: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

3.name: Winter Sawsbuck
3.description: Though there are many enthusiasts for Sawsbuck as a species, this seasonal form in particular is not very popular.

C1.name: Winter Event Sawsbuck
C1.description: It’s said that Sawsbuck are calm and easy to tame during the season when they take on this form, so it’s the perfect time to make one your partner.

0.name: Emolga
0.description: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

0.name: Karrablast
0.description: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

0.name: Escavalier
0.description: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

0.name: Foongus
0.description: This Pokémon prefers damp places. It spurts out poison spores to repel approaching enemies.

U1.name: Foombrella
U1.description: It lures humans with the hat that looks just like an umbrella, then releases poison spores.

0.name: Amoonguss
0.description: Amoonguss mimics Poké Balls. It is not yet clear whether this mimicry is effective against other Pokémon.

0.name: Frillish
0.description: Using the invisible poison spikes on its veillike arms and legs, it paralyzes its enemies and causes them to drown.

0.name: Jellicent
0.description: Fishermen are terrified of Jellicent. It’s rumored to drag them into the sea and steal their lives away.

0.name: Alomomola
0.description: They float upon the open sea. Many water Pokémon gather in the area around Alomomola.

0.name: Joltik
0.description: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

0.name: Galvantula
0.description: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

0.name: Ferroseed
0.description: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

0.name: Ferrothorn
0.description: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

0.name: Klink
0.description: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.

0.name: Klang
0.description: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

0.name: Klinklang
0.description: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.

0.name: Tynamo
0.description: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

0.name: Eelektrik
0.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

0.name: Eelektross
0.description: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

0.name: Elgyem
0.description: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

0.name: Beheeyem
0.description: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

0.name: Litwick
0.description: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

0.name: Lampent
0.description: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

U1.name: Paper Lantern Lampent
U1.description: This Pokémon appears on Lunar New Year, just before the celebration starts, so kids wait for its arrival.

0.name: Chandelure
0.description: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

0.name: Axew
0.description: If you see peculiar teeth marks on boulders or trees, it means an Axew is likely living nearby.

0.name: Fraxure
0.description: Fraxure uses its thick tusks to neatly cut prey into two portions—one to eat now and one to save for later.

0.name: Haxorus
0.description: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

0.name: Cubchoo
0.description: When Cubchoo starts sneezing, watch out! If it spatters you with its frosty snot, you’ll get frostbite.

0.name: Beartic
0.description: Feared as the Snow-White Demon in northern lands, Beartic uses its frosty claws and fangs to attack prey.

0.name: Cryogonal
0.description: Cryogonal uses its chains of ice to constrict its opponents and then flash-freezes them where they stand.

0.name: Shelmet
0.description: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

0.name: Accelgor
0.description: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

0.name: Stunfisk
0.description: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

1.name: galarian stunfisk
1.description: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

0.name: Mienfoo
0.description: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

0.name: Mienshao
0.description: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

0.name: Druddigon
0.description: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

0.name: Golett
0.description: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

0.name: Golurk
0.description: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

U1.name: Ruined Golurk
U1.description: Its seal shattered, the infernal energy inside the Ruined Golurk seeps from within. The Ruined Golurk now roams the ruined forest, as it slowly loses grasp of the identity it once had.

U2.name: Hero Golurk
U2.description: The Hero Golurk, restored through the valiant efforts of the Sinister Sages, actively protects other Pokémon from the Foul Beasts that roam the land. It seeks to make things right with those it has hurt.

0.name: Pawniard
0.description: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

0.name: Bisharp
0.description: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

0.name: Bouffalant
0.description: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

U1.name: Minotaur Bouffalant
U1.description: These Pokémon live in solitude. Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

0.name: Rufflet
0.description: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

U1.name: Pride Rufflet
U1.description: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

0.name: Braviary
0.description: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

1.name: hisuian braviary
1.description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water’s surface.

0.name: Vullaby
0.description: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

0.name: Mandibuzz
0.description: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

0.name: Heatmor
0.description: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

0.name: Durant
0.description: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

0.name: Deino
0.description: It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce, so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that moves and attempt to eat it.

0.name: Zweilous
0.description: The two heads have different likes and dislikes. Because the heads fight with each other, Zweilous gets stronger without needing to rely on others.

0.name: Hydreigon
0.description: It’s said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because people in times long past loathed it, considering it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

0.name: Larvesta
0.description: In ancient times, Larvesta was worshiped as the emissary of the sun. However, it was also viewed as a burden since it often caused forest fires.

0.name: Volcarona
0.description: This Pokémon scatters burning scales. Most of the danger of these scales is not in their heat—it’s in the way they rob the surrounding air of oxygen.

0.name: Cobalion
0.description: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

0.name: Terrakion
0.description: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

0.name: Virizion
0.description: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

0.name: Tornadus
0.description: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

1.name: therian forme tornadus
1.description: An example of what is known as a “form change,” though I suspect this strange avian guise to be Tornadus’s true form. Tornadus has been sighted crossing the ocean while in this form.

0.name: Thundurus

1.description: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

U1.name: Marshmallow Maushold
U1.description: The larger marshmallows protect the little ones during battles. When facing other opponents, they use gooey melted marshmallow strings to trap them in battle.

0.name: Fidough
0.description: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

U1.name: Hearts Fidough
U1.description: This Pokémon is sweet, and smooth to the touch. Fragrance in Fidough’s breath attracts customers into the bakery.

0.name: Dachsbun
0.description: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

H1.name: Autumn Dachsbun
H1.description: The leaves on the surface of this Pokémon’s skin change colour as Autumn rolls around, and its body has the soothing aroma of maple.

0.name: Smoliv
0.description: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

C1.name: Christmas Tree Smoliv
C1.description: This Pokémon converts snowflakes into baubles, which it stores in pine trees. It can easily go a whole week dancing around Christmas trees out of joy.

0.name: Dolliv
0.description: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

C1.name: Christmas Tree Dolliv
C1.description: It basks in the light of the stars to its heart’s content until the star on its head shines bright. After that, Christmas Tree Dolliv places the star on top of a decorated pine tree and goes on a journey for a new star.

0.name: Arboliva
0.description: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

C1.name: Christmas Tree Arboliva
C1.description: This Pokémon gathers friends by launching its rich, shiny lights at them and pulling them closer to itself.

0.name: Squawkabilly
0.description: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

1.name: Blue Plumage Squawkabilly
1.description: Blue-feathered Squawkabilly view their green-feathered counterparts as rivals, since the latter make up the largest, most powerful groups.

2.name: Yellow Plumage Squawkabilly
2.description: The yellow Squawkabilly are especially fierce. They’ve even been known to drive other bird Pokémon out of town.

3.name: White Plumage Squawkabilly
3.description: Though these Squawkabilly are the fewest in number, they have no trouble living in towns since they blend in with the white buildings.

0.name: Nacli
0.description: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

H1.name: Mushroom Nacli
H1.description: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave mushroom pieces and grass behind. Mushrooms are always being grown and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

0.name: Naclstack
0.description: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

0.name: Garganacl
0.description: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

0.name: Charcadet
0.description: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

0.name: Armarouge
0.description: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

0.name: Ceruledge
0.description: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

0.name: Tadbulb
0.description: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

0.name: Bellibolt
0.description: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

U1.name: Onigiri Bellibolt
U1.description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its rice-y body, the seaweed on its stomach keeps the rice from popping out.

0.name: Wattrel
0.description: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

0.name: Kilowattrel
0.description: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

0.name: Maschiff
0.description: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

0.name: Mabosstiff
0.description: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

0.name: Shroodle
0.description: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

0.name: Grafaiai
0.description: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

S1.name: Raincoat Grafaiai
S1.description: Every Grafaiai dresses for each occasion to paint its individual patterns all over the city.

0.name: Bramblin
0.description: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

0.name: Brambleghast
0.description: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

0.name: Toedscool
0.description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

0.name: Toedscruel
0.description: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

0.name: Klawf
0.description: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

0.name: Capsakid
0.description: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

0.name: Scovillain
0.description: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

0.name: Rellor
0.description: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

0.name: Rabsca
0.description: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

0.name: Flittle
0.description: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

0.name: Espathra
0.description: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

0.name: Tinkatink
0.description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

0.name: Tinkatuff
0.description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

0.name: Tinkaton
0.description: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

U1.name: Pride Tinkaton
U1.description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It loves to dare people to take its flag. Whoever loses, gets a firm hug.

0.name: Wiglett
0.description: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

C1.name: Candy Cane Wiglett
C1.description: Though they look like candy canes, Candy Cane Wiglett is a living pokémon. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of festive adaptation.

0.name: Wugtrio
0.description: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

0.name: Bombirdier
0.description: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

U1.name: Love Bombirdier
U1.description: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up baby Pokémon, which it carries to their parents.

0.name: Finizen
0.description: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

0.name: Palafin
0.description: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

1.name: Hero Palafin
1.description: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

0.name: Varoom
0.description: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

C1.name: Train Varoom
C1.description: The steel section is Train Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon pulls The Poké Express to the North Pole during Christmas!

0.name: Revavroom
0.description: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

0.name: Cyclizar
0.description: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

0.name: Orthworm
0.description: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

0.name: Glimmet
0.description: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

0.name: Glimmora
0.description: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

0.name: Greavard
0.description: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

0.name: Houndstone
0.description: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

0.name: Flamigo
0.description: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

0.name: Cetoddle
0.description: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

0.name: Cetitan
0.description: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

0.name: Veluza
0.description: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

0.name: Dondozo
0.description: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

0.name: Tatsugiri
0.description: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

1.name: Droopy Tatsugiri
1.description: This Pokémon tricks its opponents by playing dead. It is small and weak, but it uses its smarts to survive.

2.name: Stretchy Tatsugiri
2.description: It’s one of the most intelligent dragon Pokémon. It camouflages itself by inflating its throat sac.

0.name: Annihilape
0.description: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

0.name: Clodsire
0.description: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

0.name: Farigiraf
0.description: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

0.name: Dudunsparce
0.description: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

1.name: Three-Segment Dudunsparce
1.description: A recent study uncovered that the number of segments a Dudunsparce’s body has is determined by the Pokémon’s genes.

0.name: Kingambit
0.description: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

0.name: Great Tusk
0.description: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

0.name: Scream Tail
0.description: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

0.name: Brute Bonnet
0.description: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

0.name: Flutter Mane
0.description: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

0.name: Slither Wing
0.description: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

0.name: Sandy Shocks
0.description: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

0.name: Iron Treads
0.description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

0.name: Iron Bundle
0.description: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

0.name: Iron Hands
0.description: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

0.name: Iron Jugulis
0.description: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

0.name: Iron Moth
0.description: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

0.name: Iron Thorns
0.description: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

0.name: Frigibax
0.description: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

0.name: Arctibax
0.description: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

0.name: Baxcalibur
0.description: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

0.name: Gimmighoul
0.description: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

1.name: Roaming Gimmighoul
1.description: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

C1.name: Gingerbread Gimmighoul
C1.description: It lives inside a gingerbread house. Sometimes it gets left in gift shop corners during the holidays since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

0.name: Gholdengo
0.description: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

0.name: Wo-Chien
0.description: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

0.name: Chien-Pao
0.description: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

0.name: Ting-Lu
0.description: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

0.name: Chi-Yu
0.description: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

U1.name: Gradient Chi-Yu
U1.description: It controls the colours of flames burning at over 3,000 degrees Celsius. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

0.name: Roaring Moon
0.description: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

0.name: Iron Valiant
0.description: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

0.name: Koraidon
0.description: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

1.name: Limited Build
1.description: It has similar characteristics to a creature described in an old book as the Winged King.

0.name: Miraidon
0.description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

1.name: Low-Power Mode
1.description: It was given the name Miraidon by the professor who discovered it. Its ecology and other details are unknown.

0.name: Walking Wake
0.description: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

0.name: Iron Leaves
0.description: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

0.name: Dipplin
0.description: The head and tail appear to belong to two separate creatures; both help each other out from within their shared apple. Dipplin coat their apples with syrup produced within their bodies. The layers of fragrant syrup beguile opponents.​

0.name: Poltchageist
0.description: Poltchageist has a swirl pattern not unlike Sinistea's - but unlike Sinistea, its swirl is not a weakness. After a target is sprinkled with some of Poltchageist's powdery body or eats food dusted with it, Poltchageist drains their life-force and absorbs it as energy.​

0.name: Sinistcha
0.description: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

0.name: Okidogi
0.description: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

0.name: Munkidori
0.description: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

0.name: Fezandipiti
0.description: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

0.name: Ogerpon
0.description: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

1.name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon
1.description: In this form, it draws on the power of water. It attacks unrelentingly with kicks and ivy strikes.

2.name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon
2.description: In this form, it draws on the power of fire. It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.

3.name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon
3.description: In this form, it draws on the power of stone. Its body is rock-solid, protecting it from all manner of attacks.

0.name: Archaludon
0.description: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

0.name: Hydrapple
0.description: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

0.name: Gouging Fire
0.description: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

0.name: Raging Bolt
0.description: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

0.name: Iron Boulder
0.description: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

0.name: Iron Crown
0.description: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

0.name: Terapagos
0.description: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

1.name: Terastal Terapagos
1.description: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

2.name: Stellar Terapagos
2.description: An old expedition journal describes the sight of this Pokémon buried in the depths of the earth as resembling a planet floating in space.

0.name: Pecharunt
0.description: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
